title: Correction of a Late Payment Fee Billed on Personal Credit Cards
content:
A late payment fee is billed to a personal credit card account at the tier's own rate, but the charter does not allow the bank to keep all of it. This entitlement governs the correction credited back on such a fee on a card under Personal Credit Cards.

**When it is owed.** The credit is owed as soon as the fee stands on the account and is posted at the next reconciliation of that account, whether or not the cardholder asks for it. A card account carrying no late payment fee entry at all is out of scope of this rule and nothing is credited.

**How the credit is made.** The correction is booked by `reverse_card_late_fee_4ff0f41c`, a tool the agent unlocks and then calls. One call books a single reversal entry on the card's ledger, marked as a late payment fee reversal booked as a bank error, tied to the exact fee entry it credits against, and dated the day of the call in that day's statement cycle. The same call lowers the balance owed on the card account by the credited amount, and the cardholder sees the credit on the card's activity list and a smaller balance owed.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | The reference number of the credit card account whose ledger receives the credit and whose balance owed falls; it is read from the card account lookup for this cardholder before the call. | An identifier |
| `customer_id` | The reference number identifying the cardholder profile the credited card account belongs to; it is read from the customer profile lookup before the call. | An identifier |
| `source_item_id` | The reference number of the single late payment fee entry on that card's ledger the credit is booked against; it is read from the card activity lookup before the call. | An identifier |
| `correction_amount` | The money credited back to the cardholder for that fee, expressed exactly as the ledger records a money amount. | US dollars to 2 decimal places, or an empty string; always a positive number carried to 2 decimal places and rounded half-up. The figure itself is passed, never a percentage or a share. |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the new ledger entry's own reference number, repeats the credited amount in US dollars to two decimals, names the card account reference number, and states the balance owed after the credit, also in US dollars to two decimals. A sentence of that shape means the entry was booked and the balance was lowered; anything beginning with Error means nothing was written.
